msg.sender funds and owns the staged deposit.

msg.sender's bonded shares are credited.

Voting weight is derived from msg.sender's balance.

Timestamp dependency: epoch computation is driven by block.timestamp.
block.timestamp determines the derived epoch number used for gating.
advance relies on timestamp-derived epoch progression gated by epochTime.
permit validates 'now <= deadline', a timestamp dependency.
upgradeTo delegatecalls into the untrusted new implementation.
upgradeTo first sets the implementation via setImplementation.
commit triggers a governance-controlled implementation upgrade.
emergencyCommit triggers a super-majority implementation upgrade.
setImplementation writes the implementation slot with raw assembly.
delegatecall re-enters initialize() on the new implementation within proxy state.
permit recovers the signer from the supplied signature.
mintToAccount performs the underlying DSD mint operation.
advance's incentivized modifier mints the caller reward.
burnDSDForCDSD performs external DSD transferFrom/burn and CDSD mint.
bondCDSD pulls CDSD via external transferFrom.
unbondCDSD pushes CDSD via external transfer.
deposit performs external DSD transferFrom.
withdraw performs external DSD transfer before finalizing state.
burnDSDForCDSD requires price < 1 (contraction gate).
unbondCDSD requires price < 1 (contraction gate).
redeemBondedCDSDForDSD requires price > 1 (expansion gate).
increaseSupply increments the CDSD redeemable pool.
increaseSupply reads totalCDSDEarned to compute outstanding redeemable.
contractionIncentives updates the global interest multiplier.

bond increments the global bonded total.
bond mints shares into the global supply counter.
withdraw decrements the global staged total.
deposit increments the global staged total.
updateUserEarned refreshes deposited CDSD accounting via the multiplier.
advance advances the current epoch via Bonding.step.
Regulator.step emits epoch-indexed supply events.
mintToAccount mints through the dollar provider.
burnFromAccount transfers and burns through the dollar provider.

contraction calls contractionIncentives.

step dispatches to contraction when price < 1.
